mapper.sql: SELECT o.id,o.outbound_no,o.company_id,d.dept_name company_name,o.project_id,o.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_name,o.outbound_type,o.status,o.outbound_at,o.confirmed_at,o.completed_at,o.cancelled_at,o.operator_id,u.nick_name operator_name,o.create_time,o.remark FROM wm_outbound_order o LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=o.company_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=o.operator_id

WHERE o.del_flag='0' AND o.warehouse_id IN #{id} AND o.outbound_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{bo.outboundNo},'%') AND o.company_id=#{bo.companyId} AND o.warehouse_id=#{bo.warehouseId} AND o.status=#{bo.status} AND o.outbound_type=#{bo.outboundType} AND o.outbound_at>=#{bo.beginOutboundAt} AND o.outbound_at<=#{bo.endOutboundAt}
